  (compiled : Solidity.Evm.Compiler.Compilation b F P) {σ : Solidity.State C Γ} {base : Nat → Fin Solidity.Evm.W}
  {m m' : Solidity.Evm.Machine} {φ : Solidity.Fml C Δ},
  compiled.Input L frame base σ m →
    Solidity.holds σ (Solidity.Fml.modal Solidity.Modality.box P Solidity.Frames.nil φ) →
